recalled_knowledge.item: Z couplings g_V^f = T3/2 - Q sin^2 theta_W; nucleon vector charges (1-4 sin^2 theta_W)/4 and -1/4; g^2/(c_W^2 m_Z^2) = 4 sqrt2 G_F
Pure Higgsino neutral Dirac state couples to Z with g/(2 c_W), vector only; Majorana splitting turns it into the chi1-chi2 transition
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Higgsino DM literature (e.g. Nagata & Shirai 2015; Graham, Ramani, Wong 2025)

recalled_knowledge.item: MSSM neutralino (4x4) and chargino (2x2) mass matrices
Leading-order neutral Higgsino splitting delta = m_Z^2 (sin^2 theta_W/M1 + cos^2 theta_W/M2), tan-beta independent
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: derived here with sympy; consistent with Nagata & Shirai 2015

recalled_knowledge.item: Radiative chargino-neutralino splitting ~355 MeV for a heavy pure Higgsino
ATLAS disappearing-track bound on pure Higgsinos ~200 GeV; soft-lepton searches inapplicable at Delta m ~ 0.35 GeV
Loop-level SI cross-section of a pure Higgsino ~1e-49 to 1e-48 cm^2 with strong cancellation
LZ 2024 SI limit at 1 TeV ~5e-47 cm^2
Thermal pure Higgsino Omega h^2 = 0.12 at 1.1 TeV, Omega h^2 roughly proportional to mu^2
recalled_knowledge.presumed_source: Arkani-Hamed, Delgado, Giudice 2006; Cirelli, Fornengo, Strumia 2006

recalled_knowledge.item: Three-body weak-decay width Gamma ~ G_F^2 delta^5/(192 pi^3) per channel, used as an order-of-magnitude chi2 lifetime

failed_or_abandoned: First full run crashed in Part E: the 300 GeV N(delta) curve reaches exactly zero between grid points so the N=1 crossing was not bracketed; fixed with a 1e-8 floor in the log-interpolation and a NaN guard; the 7-minute WimPyDD grid was cached and Parts E-G rerun from it.
lz.wd_halo(day_of_year=167) with the default vmin grid truncates the June tail at 794.6 km/s; replaced by an explicit 0-830 km/s grid for all halos.
Twin-axis efficiency overlay in Figure 2 replaced by shaded efficiency<50% regions; colliding direct labels in Figure 1 replaced by a legend.
Reading Fig. 6 / Fig. S7 values by eye was superseded by exact PyMuPDF vector-path digitisation.
P002 (kinematics) and P003 (WimPyDD normalisation) were to be cited but had not been written when this paper was produced; their roles were covered by lzcommon and by our own convention check.
